title: Roller skate with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Boot body -->
  <path d='M30,45 Q30,30 45,28 L62,26 Q70,26 72,34 L74,46 Q75,52 68,54 L40,58 Q30,58 30,50 Z' fill='#ff5a7a' stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Boot cuff -->
  <rect x='48' y='18' width='24' height='14' rx='5' fill='#ff9a4a' stroke='#ffe0b3' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Cuff trim -->
  <rect x='50' y='16' width='20' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffe066' stroke='#fff5b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Sole -->
  <path d='M28,56 Q28,62 36,62 L72,58 Q78,58 78,54 L78,50 Q78,56 70,56 L36,60 Z' fill='#7b5ea7' stroke='#c9b3e6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='7' fill='#4ad9d9' stroke='#b3f5f5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#1a8a8a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='7' fill='#4ad9d9' stroke='#b3f5f5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#1a8a8a'/>
  <!-- Wheel axles/supports -->
  <rect x='34' y='62' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c9b3e6'/>
  <rect x='60' y='60' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c9b3e6'/>
  <!-- Lace holes -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- Lace crosses -->
  <path d='M52,38 L64,36' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52,42 L64,40' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#2d1b69'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#2d1b69'/>
  <path d='M46,50 Q51,56 56,50' fill='none' stroke='#2d1b69' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='46' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Toe cap shine -->
  <path d='M32,42 Q36,38 42,38' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0dc' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
